activity_summary: Edith finished the cuff and stated her terms again: payment on delivery, and the weather is not her trouble. No sum changed hands. Arthur said she let the hem down two fingers at Easter, and his shins are out. You did not order a new gown. You said you will not hurry the old man's tale. You left them the basket and went to the roll.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a new bill, and kept the tale at its length.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Finished the cuff, and restated payment on delivery.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Complained of the hem, and stood where he was told.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Edith's thread and Arthur's shins

facets.activity: Heard Edith on the cuff and Arthur on his shins

quotes.speaker: edith_kettlewood
quotes.text: Payment on delivery. The weather is your trouble, Master Shakespeare, not my thread's

quotes.speaker: arthur_meeks
quotes.text: Edith let the hem down two fingers at Easter, sir, and my shins are out in the wind again
